title: RVND governance proposal envelope
description: The typed object a governance-producing skill works with. The skill assembles intent, scope, and runtime bindings and asks RVND to generate/validate the Loomground constructs; it never writes .lg and assumes it correct. Every governance meaning is either an official Loomground construct or a visible residual. Constructs are restricted to the loomground-language 0.8.0a1 vocabulary.

intent.description: Source grounding: the user language/selection/gesture that produced the proposal.

host.description: chat | cli | sheet | other host surface

scope.description: Object grounding: the stable boundary and members this proposal governs (Versum/RVND identities, not display names).

loomground.description: Language grounding: the Loomground meaning, restricted to real constructs.

source.description: the .lg source RVND generated (skill does not author it)

type.description: A real Loomground node class, cord, or declaration. No other value is a construct - it is residual.

runtime_bindings.description: Object + runtime grounding: Loomground roles/kinds bound to RVND parties/actors and capabilities.

residual.description: The residual ledger: meaning NOT expressible in a current Loomground construct, kept visibly unresolved rather than approximated. May be empty, never omitted.

question.description: the clarification the skill may ask; it must not invent a rule instead

validation.description: The server's validation result. The skill presents this; it does not compute it.

canonical_observation.description: the language's canonical observation - the equivalence anchor across surfaces

impact.description: Runtime grounding: which RVND controls the constructs would move (the server's projection).

evidence.description: Evidence grounding: Versum spans/claims and the legal source backing each declaration.

versions.description: Version grounding: so the same input cannot mean something different later without explanation.
